name: What defines a luxury condominium, and how does it differ from a standard condo?

mainEntity.name: What defines a luxury condominium, and how does it differ from a standard condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury condominiums typically offer high-end finishes, premium amenities, prime locations, and sophisticated architectural design. While a standard condo provides basic living spaces and shared facilities, luxury properties often include features such as private elevators, concierge services, state-of-the-art fitness centers, spas, and exclusive resident lounges. The distinction also lies in the quality of materials used, the level of service, and the overall exclusivity of the community. We focus on properties in areas like Aventura, Brickell, and Sunny Isles Beach, where these premium features are standard.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury condominiums feature high-end finishes, premium amenities, prime locations, and sophisticated designs, differing from standard condos in material quality, service level, and exclusivity.
